summary: Implemented all 5 plan phases: extended sanitize_query with ligature fold + punctuation normalization, added additive chunks_trigram table with schema drift repair, implemented the fallback ladder with a degraded/fallback_tier/query_error envelope in literature-search.sh, made literature-briefing.sh render honest degraded/syntax-error messaging, and ran a full real-corpus verification sweep. Found and fixed two real bugs during Phase 3 (broken count(*) empty-check, missing conn.commit()) not anticipated by the plan.
decisions_made: fallback_tier/degraded computed from tiers surviving the #835 quarantine filter in the merged result set, not a per-db tier that may be entirely filtered out
ensure_trigram()'s empty-check uses a real MATCH probe, not count(*) (which is unreliable on external-content FTS5 tables)
ensure_trigram()'s rebuild INSERT now calls conn.commit() explicitly (previously silently rolled back)
chunks_trigram left populated on the real DB at task end; only ever dropped/recreated during deliberate lazy-migration testing, never chunks_data/chunks_fts
dead_ends: SELECT count(*) FROM chunks_trigram LIMIT 1 as an empty-check -- reports full content-table row count even on a freshly created, never-rebuilt table
Testing the trigram/syntax-error paths with the task's own literal title terms -- Phase 1's sanitizer already fixes them, so they no longer exercise those paths; real corpus terms were needed instead
